name: SlewDrv
description: 4x oversampled op-amp slew-rate limiter, hard diode clipper, thermal sag, and tone filter.

params.name: Dist
params.explanation: LM308 gain + silicon diode distortion amount (0..100).

params.name: Fltr
params.explanation: Classic RAT backwards Filter tone control (0 = bright, 100 = dark).

params.name: Tight
params.explanation: Pre-clip bass cut / Ruetz mod (0 = fat 60 Hz, 100 = tight 320 Hz).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Parallel dry/wet blend (100 = full distortion, 60-85 great on vocals).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).
